title: Australian-Style Beef Mincemeat Fritters
description: A delicious fusion of Indian flavors with Australian-style beef mincemeat fritters.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine mincemeat, garlic, onion, flour, egg, and chilli powder. Mix well.
2. Heat a non-stick pan with 1/4 cup of ghee or oil over medium heat.
3. Using a spoon, drop small portions of the mixture into the pan.
4. Flatten the mixture slightly with a spatula.
5. Cook the fritters for 4-5 minutes or until golden brown.
6. Flip the fritters and cook the other side until golden brown.
7. Serve hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
